page.overview:
Who is Derek Daly?

Derek Daly (born 11 March 1953 in Ballinteer, Dún Laoghaire–Rathdown, Dublin Region, Republic of Ireland) is a retired racing driver who competed in Formula One in the late 1970s and early 1980s.

His son, Conor Daly, was a test driver for in and currently competes in the IndyCar Series.

Daly started his career with the team in , failing to qualify for three races. In the second half of the season, he drove for , scoring a point at the . He remained at Ensign for before leaving midway through the season; gave him three races in the latter half of the year. Staying at Tyrrell for , Daly scored fourth-place finishes. Leaving for , Daly had a difficult . Daly moved to for the first three races of before he was signed by as a replacement for the retired Carlos Reutemann and scored five points finishes. At the end of the season, Daly was left without a drive and left to drive in America in the CART series.
